caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a rectangular structure and a flat, overhanging top. The majority of the cabinet, including the top, front doors, and frame, is shaded in a reddish-brown color, suggesting a wood finish. The doors are centrally placed with a distinctive cut-out design in the form of two vertically aligned circles joined by a narrower middle section. On each side of the front doors, there are vertical panels in a muted blue-gray color. The hinges and small rectangular hardware pieces on the doors are illustrated in a matching reddish-brown tone. The cabinet is shown against a plain, light beige background. In the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads "V. Van Vomis."
title: Altar for Chinese Temple
